anya (PM): heads-up — BigCorp flagged a regression after we rotated their embeddings model. Their downstream index exploded because vector dims changed. They want a formal onboarding guarantee for embedding schema stability + a documented migration/gracepath. Can we sketch something quick?

miguel (eng): ouch. do we know if it was dim mismatch or normalization differences?

sam (applied-ml): looks like both. new model returns 768 dims, old was 1024, and cosine distances shifted because of different prep/tokenization.

anya (PM): customer expects two things: (1) an onboarding SLO — embedding dimension + dtype compatibility for N days post-swap, (2) a migration toolkit / shim so they don't have to reindex everything immediately.

elaine (acct): BigCorp contract clause: 30d notice + compatibility guarantee for "no breaking change to vector schema" else we provide credits. They escalated to legal. Need a product answer by EOD.

miguel (eng): technical options: pad/truncate vectors (zero-pad or PCA-based), provide a server-side adapter that exposes the old schema, or keep both models behind the API and route by customer pin/version. Costs vary.

jordan (devex): we can ship a small compatibility shim as a library + a server-side flag: embed_schema_version in response metadata. Idea: add response header `x-embed-schema: v1` and an endpoint `POST /compat/upgrade` that runs a background re-encode/reindex job.

sam (applied-ml): for quality/regression control we need a benchmark harness: runner that computes hit-rate / MRR on customer prompt-set vs their index. Regression threshold gating (e.g., <2% drop) for automatic rollouts.

anya (PM): propose the following short-term policy for BigCorp: 30d gracepath where we offer either (A) server-side adapter (pad/truncate + renorm) or (B) pin to old model for their traffic while they reindex. During gracepath we run weekly quality checks and rollback if >5% MRR drop.

miguel (eng): pragmatic MVP for adapter: padding/truncation + L2 renormalize. Example pseudocode we can ship in 1 sprint:```python
def compat_vector(v_new, target_dim):
    if len(v_new) < target_dim:
        return np.pad(v_new, (0, target_dim-len(v_new)))
    return v_new[:target_dim]

# then renormalize
return compat_vector(v_new, target_dim) / np.linalg.norm(compat_vector(v_new, target_dim))```

jordan (devex): add `embed_schema_version` to model manifest, plus migration docs and a `compatibility-check` CLI: `ri-compat check --old-model m1 --new-model m2 --dataset D` that outputs MRR/delta.

elaine (acct): customers will want a clear opt-in for auto-adapter vs reindex. Can we make the choice explicit in console and in the SLA?

anya (PM): yes — UI toggle + API param `compat_mode: auto_adapter|pin_old|reindex_schedule`. Default = pin_old for enterprise accounts during 30d.

miguel (eng): risk: adapter can hide semantic shifts; we must warn about vector quality. Need audit logs + `compatibility_check_id` in requests so customers can correlate.

sam (applied-ml): add a regression alert channel and auto-eval snapshots. If weekly check shows MRR drop >5% -> notify, and if >10% -> auto-fallback to pinned model.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/compat-adapter -> staging (canary 10%) scheduled 2026-03-22T02:00Z :rocket:

anya (PM): next steps: 1) eng builds adapter MVP (1 sprint) — miguel owns. 2) devex docs + CLI — jordan. 3) eval harness + alerting — sam. 4) legal + acct language for gracepath + opt-ins — elaine.

miguel (eng): noted. I'll sketch PR with the adapter and a lightweight canary route. Also will add metrics: `compat.apply_count`, `compat.passed_mrr_checks`.

jordan (devex): I'll draft the CLI and docs. Will need a sample dataset from BigCorp — can we ask them for a 10k sample and baseline index?

elaine (acct): I'll request the sample and push the contract amendment draft.

anya (PM): ok. I'll capture this as an onboarding rubric: "Embedding Schema Stability" with fields: required_dim, dtype, embed_schema_version, compatibility_options, grace_period_days, regression_thresholds. I'll drop into the catalog entry template and link to the PR.

miguel (eng): quick question: do we want to force schema version bumps to require explicit model-catalog review?

sam (applied-ml): yes — require eval harness pass + catalog review for major schema changes (dim/dtype). Minor normalization changes get a compatibility check.

anya (PM): agreed. I'll add gating to the catalog onboarding checklist.

elaine (acct): thanks — will update BigCorp with this plan and timeline. Please mark the ticket high priority. :+1:
